name: @pipeworx/mcp-expression-atlas

tools.name: search_experiments
tools.description: Search EBI Expression Atlas — ~4,500 curated gene/protein expression experiments (baseline & differential) across species, tissues, and conditions. Filter by keyword (matches description/experimental factors), species (e.g. "Homo sapiens", "Mus musculus"), and/or type ("Baseline" or "Differential"). Returns accession, description, species, type, assay count, and factors. Keyless. Complements UniProt/Ensembl.

query.description: Keyword matched (case-insensitive) against experiment description OR any experimental factor, e.g. "liver", "stress", "cancer".

species.description: Species substring (case-insensitive), e.g. "Homo sapiens", "Mus musculus", "Arabidopsis thaliana".

tools.name: get_experiment
tools.description: Get metadata for a single EBI Expression Atlas experiment by accession (e.g. "E-MTAB-4045"). Returns accession, description, species, type, assay count, and experimental factors.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-expression-atlas forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the expression-atlas pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
